AT&T.title: AT&T
AT&T.wikitext:
[[File:AT&T Lines in 1891.jpg|thumb|181x181px|AT&T Lines in 1891]]{{Delete}}
AT&T can trace its origin back to the original Bell Telephone Company founded by Alexander Graham Bell after his invention of the telephone. One of that company's subsidiaries was the American Telephone and Telegraph Company (AT&T), established in 1885, which acquired the Bell Company on December 31, 1899 for legal reasons, leaving AT&T as the main company. AT&T established a network of subsidiaries in the United States and Canada that held a government-authorized phone service monopoly, formalized with the Kingsbury Commitment, throughout most of the twentieth century. This monopoly was known as the Bell System, and during this period, AT&T was also known by the nickname Ma Bell. For periods of time, the former AT&T was the world's largest phone company.  



[[Stanley Yelnats I]] had apparently done some business with them, as when his stolen chest was recovered in 2003 by [[Stanley Yelnats IV]] and [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]], it was opened by [[Stanley Yelnats III]], and as they inspected the stock forms within the chest, as well as a pile of gold treasures. [[Stanley Yelnats II]] held up a document and said, "AT&T!" By that time, the AT&T stock had most likely gone into the millions.

[[File:AT&T Logo 1983-2003.png|thumb|131x131px|AT&T's old logo used from 1983 to when Stanely and Zero found the chest in 2003]]
[[File:Theodore Newton Vail.png|thumb|118x118px|Theodore Newton Vail]]
Two years after Stanley Yelnats IV discovered Stanley I's chest, AT&T Corporation was acquired by “Baby Bell,” also known as the Regional Bell Operating Company, which then became the new AT&T. The American Telephone & Telegraph Company lasted until 2024, when it was succeeded by this new AT&T. Between Yelnats I’s robbery by Katherine Barlow in 1919 and the chest’s discovery in 2003, AT&T underwent major changes. In the 1950s, they began renting out phones like the Standard Western Electric 500-type set and produced modems for mainframes of the time. In the 1980s, they launched cordless phones and the AT&T Personal Computer 6300, and in the 1990s, they developed internet modems. The company also saw significant growth from 1900 to 1919 under its president, Theodore Newton Vail (July 16, 1845 – April 16, 1920).

Austin, Texas (currently)|race=Black|image1=Armpit Box.png}} == Before Camp Green Lake == Theodore was arrested and sent to Camp Green Lake at the age of 14 for being the target then beating up two older boys at a movie theatre, over a spilled bucket of popcorn. == At Camp Green Lake == Theodore arrived at Camp Green Lake, was assigned to [[D-Tent]] and received his nickname, Armpit. He received this nickname because of his body odor. Armpit was introduced by Squid to Stanley, alongside [[Magnet (Jose)|Magnet]], [[Zigzag (Ricky)|Zigzag]], and [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)|Zero]]. While Stanley was at Camp Green Lake, Armpit became his "mentor" as assigned by [[Mr. Pendanski]]. Anyone who called Armpit by his real name, Theodore, would get shoved to the ground by him when Mr Pendanski wasn't present. After witnessing Stanley stand up to the [[Lump]] in the Wreck Room alongside the other D Tent boys, Armpit respected Stanley and acknowledged him under his newly given nickname Caveman. In the novel, Armpit explains to the Lump that 'no one messes with the Caveman'. In the film, Magnet delivers this line instead. == After Camp Green Lake == In the film, Armpit writes down his mother's phone number and asks Caveman to call her on Armpit's behalf to apologise. In the original novel, the plea to Caveman is given by [[Squid (Alan)|Squid]]. Also in the film, X-Ray was happy for Stanley and wished him good luck in the real world outside of camp. In the novel, Armpit delivers this line. Armpit was released from Camp Green Lake after it was closed down, where he spent 6 months living in a halfway house in San Antonio whilst attending school and receiving counselling. At the current age of 17, he is living on the east of Austin, Texas with his parents, trying to make a better life for himself. Armpit currently works for a landscaping company under his boss Jack Dunleavy called Raincreek Irrigation and Landscaping digging trenches and assembling pipes. When X-Ray calls Armpit by his nickname, Armpit, now having a change of heart tells X-Ray not to call him that, especially in front of other people including his boss. He gets involved in a ticket scalping scheme with [[X-Ray (Rex Washburn)|X-Ray]] to see pop star, Kaira De Leon by buying 12 tickets. The scheme starts off well with tickets originally valued at $55 each, then $60 due to having an added $5 service charge, eventually with the starting profit of $660. Then it goes pear-shaped after X-Ray confessed to Armpit that he made two copies of the last two tickets which were counterfeit valued at $300 each and were originally priced at $135 according to Armpit. The last two original tickets were sold to ticket sellers, Felix and Moses. The two hear about the incident and beat up X-Ray. Armpit comes to his aide. He and Ginny, his next-door neighbour, met Kaira DeLeon and after a short period of time, Kaira and Armpit started falling in love with one another, with Kaira inviting Armpit over to San Francisco where Kaira also eventually finds out about Armpit and his nickname. The two break up however at San Francisco's Chinatown after Kaira realizes Armpit was part of a ticket scalping scheme, and that he wanted a letter from her, to give to Felix so he wouldn't tell Detective Newberg about the ticket scalping, resulting in Armpit getting coffee poured by Kaira in anger and leaving. Kaira also alleges that she thought she kissed X-Ray. Armpit then saved Kaira's life in a fight with her stepfather Jerome 'El Genius' Paisley. The ticket scalping situation is given the all-clear afterwards after Detective Newberg of the Austin Police Department, tells Armpit that X-Ray was reluctant to sell the tickets at first because he promised that they were for him. In the aftermath of the accident, Kaira, though still beaten up, makes one final song near the ending of the Small Steps novel in her weakened state, detailing the ups and downs about her and Armpit's relationship. Armpit realises and learns that he can't rely on his relationship around her and has to move on, going back to focusing on his 5 key goals: 1) To graduate from high school. 2) Attend two years at Austin Community College. 3) Do well enough to transfer to the University of Texas. 4) To not do anything stupid. and 5) To lose the nickname Armpit. Carla Morengo.wikitext:

–
Ms. Morengo is Stanley Yelnats IV's lawyer who got hired by [[Tiffany Yelnats]] to get Stanley out of Camp Green Lake after they got the money by selling the foot odor cure that Stanley Yelnats III made with peaches and onions in bottles. Later, she brought Attorney General of Texas to help get Stanley out of Camp Green Lake. She is Hispanic and speaks with a slight Mexican accent in the novel.   

Later, Armpit asks her for a pen and paper, and then Mr. Sir gets recognized as Marion Sevillo, The Warden is recognized as Louise Walker and Mr. Pendanski gets proven to be a fake doctor*. Mr. Sir, Mr. Pendanski and The Warden then get arrested for being in possession of a firearm (Which was against parole), treating the campers like slaves, endangering their lives, destroying Zero's files, and being proven a fraud doctor*. In the film she is portrayed by Roma Maffia.  

In the film, Ms Morengo uses a black Jaguar X-Type for transportation and takes Stanley and Zero with her upon Stanley's release from Camp Green Lake, however in the book she uses an unknown BMW car to pick up Stanley and Zero.  

Additionally in the novel, after Mr Pendanski makes the announcement that Hector Zeroni's file is misplaced, the Attorney General makes a further call to his office and states the contradiction of Mr Pendanski that Hector's files are indeed found in his office database but he is having difficulty accessing or is unable to access them. telling Ms Morengo that Zero was incarcerated but cannot reveal why, before Ms Morengo takes Zero with her.  

Ms Morengo also has curly brown hair in the film, unlike the novel, where she has straight black hair.    

According to Ms Morengo in the novel, she did investigating that Clyde's shoes were stolen before 3:15 PM followed by Stanley fishing his notebook out of the toilet at 3:20 PM, according to Stanley's high school bully, Derrick Dunne and that two girls saw Stanley leave the restroom carrying the wet notebook at the time.

July 16th, 1982), nicknamed '''Caveman''' at Camp Green Lake, is the main protagonist of ''Holes''. He is portrayed by Shia LaBeouf in the movie. == Biography == === Arrest === In 1996, at the young age of 14 a pair of shoes flew off a bridge and hit Stanley in the head as he was walking home, knocking him to the ground. Stanley decided to take the shoes home. Coincidentally, they had been donated to an orphanage by the baseball player Clyde "Sweet Feet" Livingston, who was the original owner of the shoes. When the police caught Stanley, believing he had stolen them, he was sentenced to eighteen months at Camp Green Lake. === At Camp Green Lake === When he arrives at Camp Green Lake, he meets Mr. Sir, the head counsellor. He warns Stanley that he can run away, but he'll die soon after, as there is no water for at least one hundred miles from the camp. He also states that Camp Green Lake is "not a Girl Scout Camp", which he mentions throughout the story. Stanley later meets his roommates from his tent: [[Armpit]], [[Squid (Alan)|Squid]], [[Magnet]], [[X-Ray]], [[Zigzag]] and [[Zero]]. Everyone but Zero in the group bully or tease him for a while. In D-Tent, Stanley was reading a letter from his mother. While he does this, Zero looks at it over Stanley's shoulders, causing Stanley to tell Zero that he does not like people reading his letters. However, Zero reveals that he is illiterate and cannot read and asks Stanley to teach him. Stanley tries to back out of it, saying he's 'not a teacher' and that he is too tired from digging holes all day. The D-Tent boys still razzed Stanley until one day, when Stanley was bumped into the camp's resident bully, The [[Lump]], by accident. The Lump kicked Stanley away, and when he tried to right himself and apologize, he slipped on an unstable stool, and landed on the bully, making it appear like he tried to take The Lump on. The Lump attempted to beat up Stanley, but the other [[D-Tent]] boys backed Stanley up, calling The Lump off with fear of reprisals from the Warden. After the event, Squid told Stanley to ''Not even look at him'' When they remarked on The Caveman '"You see Caveman back there?" [[Armpit]] replied in amazement ''"Nobody'' messes with the Caveman. ''Nobody''."' Stanley assumed he meant The Lump was the Caveman, until [[Magnet]] called to Stanley, "You comin', Caveman?" He was now one of them. Stanley continued to send letters to his mom to stop her from worrying. Soon after, X-Ray makes Stanley promise that if he found anything, he'd give it to him, because he had been there longer than Stanley, and because X-Ray still hadn't found anything since he had arrived at the camp six months prior. Soon, Stanley discovered a bullet-shaped lipstick tube with the initials "K.B" engraved on it--while pondering whether it really belonged to the famous outlaw--and proceeds to deliver it to X-Ray, albeit under duress- X-Ray was almost done and Stanley was going to still be working all day. X-Ray got in his face, challenging, "Yeah? ''So?''" Since there was no way to convince X-Ray otherwise, so Stanley decided to honour his original agreement, and suggest that X-Ray save it for the next day, since X-Ray was almost done with his hole anyway. "Show it to Mom the next day and get the ''whole day'' off." X-Ray had won, Stanley had given in, but he also gave him an idea that he ''hadn't'' considered. X-Ray was impressed, and proceeded to show the lip-stick tube to [[Mr. Pendanski]] the next morning, and called The Warden, who gave X-Ray the day off, a double shower token... ''"And a snack."'' A couple of days later, Magnet steals Mr. Sir's sunflower seeds and passes the burlap sack containing them around. ZigZag threw it to Stanley, but it landed in Stanley's hole in the process ("Aww, Stanley, you butter-fingers!"). Mr. Sir soon drives back, having noticed his seeds were stolen. When Stanley took the blame for taking the sunflower seeds, he was confronted by Mr. Sir, and they went to the Warden's cabin. The Warden, expecting that Stanley had found what she was looking for, was annoyed because of the disturbance, and severely injured Mr. Sir in the face by scratching him with her nails (coated with nail polish containing rattlesnake venom). She then tells Stanley to return to his hole to dig. After returning to his respective hole, Stanley realizes that Zero already dug it. Stanley makes an agreement with Zero that if Stanley teaches him to read, Zero will dig part of Stanley's hole every day. Zero also reveals that his real name is Hector Zeroni. Throughout the lessons, Hector revealed that he'd been homeless most of his life. When Hector mentioned that he used to wait at Laney Park, Stanley smiled in amazement; he used to go to Laney Park all the time. However, he saddened when Hector told him that he used to sleep in the tunnel next to the swinging bridge at the park. A few days after, Zigzag and Squid start to antagonize Stanley due to Zero digging a part of his hole every day. Zigzag then starts provoking Stanley, Mr. Pendanski actually egging them on, so Stanley fights back, and Zigzag violently batters Stanley, in which Zero retaliates by jumping on his back and nearly choking Zigzag to death. This forces Pendanski to fire his shotgun into the sky to scare them apart. The altercation caused the Warden to come over and intervene. Zigzag starts telling the Warden what happened, where the Warden tells Stanley to dig his own hole after the boys tell her that Zero was digging it for him. Afterwards, Mr. Pendanski makes fun of Zero for "being stupid" and rudely insults him by asking what "D-I-G" spells. Zero hits Pendanski in the face with the shovel (knocking Mr. Pendanski unconscious) and yelling, ''"DIG!"'' He then soon runs into the distance. Stanley cheers him on as he runs, and the Warden tells Mr. Sir to let him leave. She orders that all water supplies are monitored around the clock and that Zero's files are destroyed. She pours water on Mr. Pendanski to wake him up, to which he says, "I'll have the chicken tenders, Warden." before falling over again and making the boys laugh. The Warden tells Stanley that she still expects seven holes and leaves. Following the departure of Zero, a new kid fills his spot, named "Twitch" (for his fidgety behaviour). Determined to find Zero, Stanley steals Mr. Sir's water truck, while Twitch tells him how to start the truck - Twitch had gotten arrested for joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Stanley starts driving but soon drives into a hole. Stanley flees from the scene, running into the desert. He eventually finds a dusty rowboat that says "Mary Lou" on the side. He looks under it, only to find Zero under it, still alive. He was overjoyed and hugged Zero, glad he was alive, but in a weak state, drinking some type of substance, a peachy and cinnamon-y orange substance, dubbed "sploosh." Although Stanley tried to encourage him to go back to Camp Green Lake, where there is water, Zero was not convinced. When he asked Stanley what "Mare-Yelo" meant, Stanley and Zero went outside of the makeshift shelter and realized it was "Mary Lou" (The name of [[Sam]]'s beloved mule). Stanley looked at the mountain in the distance, its odd stone outcropping resembling a wenis. "Wujie's Wenis" Stanley realizes, and he and Hector journey off. Once, when he was younger, Stanley's great-grandfather got stuck in the desert after being robbed by Kate Barlow, and told the people who rescued him that he had found refuge on Wujie's Wenis. Stanley slips and nearly falls from the mountain but Hector catches him with the shovel, cutting his hands in the process. As they travelled upward, Hector got sick from the 100-year-old `Sploosh'; It kept him alive, but at a price. So Stanley carried Hector up the mountain, unknowingly fulfilling part of the promise to [[Madame Zeroni]]. They finally made it to the top of the mountain that situates "Wujie's Wenis", where there was an uphill stream and, surprisingly, a field of large, sweet onions. Unbeknownst to them, it was Sam's 150-year-old onion field, full of a new generation of huge, sweet onions with healing properties. Hector ate a few of the onions, so the next day, he was feeling better, as the onions cured his stomach pains. As Stanley lay back in the refreshing stream, he softly sang the "[[If Only, If Only]]" family song from his great-great-grandfather, while Hector was in his weakened state. Unknowingly, this lifted the curse that plagued the four generations of the Yelnats family. Later, Hector tells Stanley the truth about Clyde Livingston's shoes, where he stole them from the orphanage and threw them from the overpass when he heard police coming, causing them to land on Stanley. Stanley, completely forgiving Hector, replied that he felt lucky, and decided to visit the hole where he'd found the lipstick tube. Not too long after, the duo return to Camp Green Lake, where they dig up the hole in which the golden brass lipstick tube was contained in. In the hole, a suitcase was discovered with a label that reads " Stanley Yelnats.": Stanley's great-grandfather, who was robbed by Kate Barlow. Unfortunately, Mr. Pendanski, Mr. Sir, and the Warden discovered the boys in the hole, `thanking' them for finding it for her. They are not able to move, however, because the hole happens to be the home of many of the lethal, yellow-spotted lizards, although Stanley and Hector do not get bitten due to eating a large sum of onions prior - the lizards hated `onion blood'. Mr. Pendanski taunts Stanley by informing him that he was innocent and was supposed to be released, but "Too bad you weren't there!". The Warden and the counsellors stay up until 4:30 in the morning, monitoring the boys until daybreak. The attorney general of Texas and Stanley's lawyer arrive at the camp, where the lawyer, [[Ms. Morengo|Carla Morengo]], is there to pick Stanley up, whereas the A.G. is there to inspect the camp itself. It is revealed that the Warden (real name Louise Walker), Mr. Sir (paroled criminal Marion Sevillo), and Pendanski (revealed to be a fraudulent doctor) are all arrested under the laws of justice. Hector was allowed to go with Stanley since Mr. Pendanski was ordered by the Warden to destroy Hector's records after he escaped and Stanley says he won't leave without him. Armpit gives Stanley his mother's phone number and asks him to call her and tell her that "Theodore is sorry." === After Camp Green Lake === When Stanley and Hector were at Stanley's house, they open the treasure chest filled with jewels, deeds, and other valuable items. The Yelnats split the money with Hector. Stanley and Zero receive less than $1,000,000 each. Stanley uses the money to buy a new house with a laboratory in the basement, and for Zero to hire a team of private investigators to help find his mother 1 and half years later. Stanley then watches Hector's mom and Hector reunite and they go home safely. In addition, Stanley's father figured out the right ingredient to the foot odor solution, precisely on the same day that the curse of the Yelnats's was lifted, peaches and onions. All of the boys at Camp Green Lake were released, and Ms. Walker was forced to sell her family's land in desperate need of money. Stanley and Hector, now next-door neighbours in large houses, were having a pool party with all of the boys from the former D-Tent. Among the guests was [[Clyde Livingston]], who was in the new commercial for the foot deodorizer made by the Yelnats', `Sploosh'. Later, Camp Green Lake was bought, extensively remodeled, and turned into a Girl Scout Camp.{{Characters}} [[Category:Characters in Movie]] [[Category:Characters in Book]] [[Category:Main Characters]] [[Category:Campers]] [[Category:Camp Green Lake]] [[Category:Characters]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Alive]] [[Category:Latvian]]

==Early Life at Green Lake==
[[File:Captures.PNG|thumb|221x221px|Trout Walker in Green Lake]]
As a young 22-year-old man in 1902, Trout was the son of the landlord who owned the area containing the lake in Green Lake, Texas, and it was easily his favorite thing to boast about. He was a bigoted and self-centered man, often using his relationship to the land owner to get what he wanted. He was openly racist, much of it being directed at the African American onion picker named [[Sam]], whom Trout was jealous of since he wanted to be romantically involved with the local school teacher, [[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow)|Katherine (Kate) Barlow]], who was interested in Sam instead. After Katherine told Trout that she had no interest in him, Trout caught her kissing Sam, which infuriated him.* He had the Sheriff arrest him (as it was illegal for a black man to kiss a white woman) and slate him for hanging, while his mob of friends burned down the schoolhouse. Sam made an attempt to escape in his rowboat along with several jars of Katherine's peaches, but was shot dead by an enraged Trout Walker on his motorboat.

''*In the book, it was not Trout, but Hattie Parker who caught them.''

==After the Lake Dried Up==
[[File:Trout Box.png|thumb|Trout with his rifle]]
[[File:Trout and louise walker digging holes.png|thumb|316x316px|Trout and his granddaughter digging holes]]
After Sam was murdered, it never rained again in Green Lake. Eventually Trout Walker's main source of wealth quite literally dried up. In the meantime, the grieving Katherine Barlow turned into an infamous bandit/outlaw nicknamed "Kissin Kate Barlow", while Trout, now 30 would go on to woo and marry the 17 year old [[Linda Walker|Linda Miller]] (who was one of Kate Barlow's students when Sam was murdered) in 1911. By 1924, Trout and his wife Linda, now desperate and poor, tracked down Kate Barlow, who had now been an outlaw for 20 years, threatening her with torture in order to discover the location where she buried her loot obtained in her years as a bandit. Trout and Linda find her resting near Sam's boat in the movie, while in the novel, they find her in the log cabin that is later owned by Trout. To escape their torture, Kate committed suicide by making a Yellow-Spotted lizard bite her on the arm in the movie, and accidentally on the ankle in the novel. As she died, she had a smile on her face, taunting him and denying the man his wishes even in death while laughing. 
[[File:Trout-walker-thats-too-damn-bad.jpg|thumb|308x308px|Trout Walker in his elderly age telling his granddaughter: "That's too damn bad! You keep digging!"]]
With Trout's only way to find the treasure now dead he simply began to dig for the remainder of his life. His obsession with finding the treasure infected his children and grandchildren, even after his death in 1963 at the age of 81, when his granddaughter [[The Warden|Louise Walker]] was 15. With The Warden's memory of having to dig holes even on Christmas, she tells her grandfather Trout that she is tired of it. Trout responds saying 'that it's too damn bad. You keep digging'. The Warden sarcastically responds her famous line: 'Well, excuse me.' Trout tells The Warden that she'll thank him one day before spitting.
[[File:Trout-walker-you'll-thank-me-one-day.png|thumb|313x313px|Trout Walker in his elderly age telling his granddaughter: "You'll thank me one day."]]
As a young woman a few years later, Louise Walker would go on to set up Camp Green lake (with herself as The Warden) to have the teenaged campers dig massive holes every day until the treasure was found. Ironically, the treasure turned out to be the rightful property of the Yelnats family, as the chest had [[Stanley Yelnats I|the original Stanley Yelnats' name on it]], making Trout's death all for nothing.

As depicted in the movie, Trout Walker drives a 1958 Chrysler Saratoga which is later driven by his granddaughter for transportation.

The Girl Scouts of the United States of America (GSUSA), commonly called in America as simply the Girl Scouts, is a youth organization for girls in the United States and American girls living abroad. Founded by Juliette Gordon Low in 1912, it was organized after Low met Robert Baden-Powell, the founder of Scouting, in 1911.[2] Upon returning to Savannah, Georgia, she telephoned a distant cousin, saying, "I've got something for the girls of Savannah, and all of America, and all the world, and we're going to start it tonight!"[3] 

GSUSA aims to empower girls and to help teach values such as honesty, fairness, courage, compassion, character, sisterhood, confidence, and citizenship through activities including camping, community service, learning first aid, and earning badges by acquiring practical skills. Girl Scouts' achievements are recognized through rank advancement and by various special awards such as the Girl Scout Bronze, Silver, and Gold Awards.

In [[Holes]], [[Mr. Sir (Marion Sevillo)|Mr. Sir]] used "Girl Scout(s)" as an insult, meaning `Girly, dainty, delicate, and weak'. "This isn't a Girl Scout camp!" "This isn't the Girl Scouts!" "It sure ain't the Girl Scouts sellin' cookies."

Mr. Sir’s past offenses involved Girl Scouts - they tried to poison him with cyanide but he found a way to be immune to them, and became corrupted, like how he did with [[Squid (Alan)]]. The Girl Scout was originally Camp Green Lake, but Camp Green Lake closed down and it got bought by The Girl Scouts of the United States of America.

Green Lake, Texas.wikitext:

[[File:Camp-green-lake-sign-md.png|thumb|238x238px]]
'''Camp Green Lake''' was a juvenile delinquent detention camp which had once used to be a town, located near Green Lake, a natural tidal lake in Calhoun County of Texas. 

==Description==
The lake had once used to be a town, but now it's a juvenile delinquent detention camp. The camp is run by the family that owned the town. There once was a lake at Camp Green Lake. However, that lake dried up long and was under the ownership of [[The Warden (Louise Walker)|The Warden]].  

Mr Sir gave the excuse numerous times to campers that they are digging holes here to build character under her rule. However, the real reason behind her doing this, was to have the campers dig to attempt to find the location of the loot hidden in the desert by [[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow)]].   

==As a town.==
When Camp Green Lake was a town, it was known only as Green Lake. There once was a lake where there is only desert now. The town located next to the lake was a prosperous small town. The lake was owned by the Walkers. There was only one school house in the town. The teacher of the school was [[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow)|Katherine Barlow]], who grew delicious peaches which she often traded for services. She and the onion salesman [[Sam]] who often traded with each other. One day, while it was raining, Sam came to her school house to give her some onions. He noticed a leaky roof and said he'd fix it for her for some peaches. Kate began to fall in love with Sam the more he was around. So she kept finding things to have Sam fix around the school house. The two fell in love, and one day when Sam was comforting Kate, they kissed. In the book, they were seen by Hattie Parker (a resident of Green Lake at the time) and she screamed at them. In the movie Trout Walker rode past on horseback and saw them kissing. Sam was subsequently shot and killed while riding his boat to his onion field. Kate then killed the sheriff of the town for he was useless when they murdered Sam. He was drunk and demanded she kiss him. After Kate killed him, she became the infamous outlaw '''Kissing Kate Barlow'''. After Sam's death, it never rained in Green Lake until justice was served on the Walker family.

==As a Camp==
Camp Green Lake remained in the possession of the Walker family. The Warden, owner of the camp, who is a member of the Walker family, was forced to dig a hole for the loot buried somewhere in the desert when she was a little girl. The other staff of this camp are [[Mr. Sir (Marion Sevillo)|Mr. Sir]], [[Mr. Pendanski (Mom)|Mr. Pendanski]], and multiple unnamed counselors. This made her able to have the young men in the camp to dig the holes for her. The camp was split into 6 different tents. They were lettered A-F. The only tent that ever has camper's names revealed is D Camp, which is the tent Stanley is placed in upon his arrival. The camp had no electric fence, no guard towers, or anything at all to keep the campers from running away. The only sources of shade are two old oak trees with a log cabin as The Warden's main source of shelter along with a hammock to lie on if she needed a break. 

The logic they had behind this was that they had the only source of water for 100 miles (160 kilometres). However, this was proven untrue when [[Stanley Yelnats IV (Caveman)]] and  [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]] climbed to the top of "[[Wujie's Wenis]]" and found an onion field and a small stream. 

While at camp, Stanley found a lip stick tube in one of his holes. He gave it to [[X-Ray (Rex Washburn)]] because X-Ray had demanded Stanley give him whatever he found and Stanley did not want to get on X-Ray's bad side. Stanley marked the hole he found the tube in with a giant rock. When Stanley and Zero ran away, the Warden has Mr. Pendanski destroy the files of Zero. However, they didn't know how they'd explain why Stanley ran away. This is because Stanley would have had to run away ''after'' he was told he'd be released soon. When Stanley and Zero returned to look for Kissin' Kate's loot, they went to the hole Stanley marked with the giant rock. When Stanley and Zero uncovered the loot, which turned out to be the loot stolen from Stanley's great grandfather by Kate, they pulled out the chest only to find it was covered in Yellow Spotted Lizards. However, since they had eaten plenty of onions on "Wujie's Wenis" (a rock mountain shaped as a wenis), the lizards wouldn't attack Stanley or Zero. When Stanley's attorney [[Carla Morengo|Ms Morengo]] arrived with a court order to have him released, she wasn't alone. She brought the Texas Attorney General and a few of his staff with her. Stanley and Zero eventually climbed out of the hole. Later that day, The Warden Mr. Pendanski and Mr. Sir has been arrested when the Attorney General finds out that they had destroyed Zero's files. The camp was shut down and reopened as a girl scout camp due to The Warden's need to financially support herself. 

In the sequel of Holes, ''Stanley Yelnats' Survival Guide to Camp Green Lake'', Camp Green Lake and a neighboring camp for girls were reopened after the book ''Holes'' became popular among politicians and law enforcement. It is unknown what happened to the girl scout camp.

== Trivia ==

* While the book states that the weather was said to be 95° in Fahreinhait (35° Celsius) in the shade, filming in the movie was actually at 150° in Fahreinhait (65.5°  Celsius). Also, the film location would actually be shot near Ridgecrest, California in the Mojave Desert, rather than [[wikipedia:Green_Lake_(Texas)|Green Lake, Calhoun County, Texas]] itself.
* While the Camp Green Lake Juvenile Correctional Facility states in its guidelines in the novel that it is against the law in Texas to bring explosives, weapons and drugs onto the premises, Mr Sir is in clear violation as he used his gun both in the movie and the novel as he was still on parole. Examples include Mr Sir asking Stanley if he wanted to run away, shortly after he arrived while Stanley looked at Mr Sir's gun in the novel. Also in the movie, he fired a shot while at night trying to keep watch for yellow spotted lizards.
* Mr Pendanski would've also broken the weapon violation rule as he used his rifle in the movie (pistol in the novel) to break up Zero and Zigzag's fight by firing in the air.

'''''[[Holes]]''''' is a book written by '''''[[Louis Sachar]]'''''. It was adapted into a film by '''''[https://www.disney.com/ Disney]'''''

== Book ==
[[File:Holes.jpg|thumb|The Book Holes]]
This was originally a book. It was written in 1998 by Louis Sachar. It was produced by Yearling. It won the following awards: 

* ''Newberry Medal''
* ''National Book Award''
* ''Boston Globe- Horn Book Award''
* ''ALA Best Book for Young Adults''
* ''ALA Notable Book''
* ''ALA Quick Pick''
* ''Christopher Award for Juvenile Fiction''
* ''New York Times Book Review Notable Childrens Book of the Year''
* ''A Horn Book Fanfare''
* ''Publishers Weekly Book of the Year''
* ''Bulletin Blue Ribbon Book''
* ''School Library Journal Best Book of the Year''

It was dedicated "To Sherre, Jessica, Lori, Kathleen, and Emily and to Judy Allen, a fifth-grade teacher from whom we all can learn."

== Movie ==
[[File:51FQJVW7S3L.jpg|thumb|The Movie Holes]]
The book was adapted into a movie in 2003 with Shia LaBeouf starring as Stanley. Louis Sachar actually took part in the creation of the script for the movie, which is why the book and movie are similar.

==Hole's Character List==
A list of all the characters in ''Holes''.

==Camp Green Lake Characters==
# [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]] was the real culprit in stealing Clyde Livingstons shoes. Zero is an orphan and when Stanley carried Zero up Wujie's Wenis, Stanley unknowingly broke the Yelnats family curse, because Zero is a '''<big>descendant</big>''' of Madame Zeroni.
#[[X-Ray (Rex Washburn)]] - The unofficial leader of Group D at Camp Green Lake. Everybody listens to him (including Stanley)
#[[Armpit (Theodore Johnson)|Armpit (Theodore Johnson) ]]- A boy in Group D who has very bad body odor.
#[[Magnet (Jose)|Magnet (Jose) ]]- Another boy in Group D, his fingers are supposedly like little magnets.
#[[Zigzag (Ricky)|Zigzag (Ricky) ]]- A violent, abusive boy who suffers from acute paranoia (which means he's crazy) and has hair which looks like he's been electrocuted and is taller than all the other boys in Group D.
#[[Squid (Alan)]] - A boy in Group D.
#[[Twitch (Brian)|Twitch (Brian) ]]- The boy who replaces Zero and does a lot of fidgeting.
#[[The Warden|The Warden ]]- She runs Camp Green Lake. She is also known to be violent and abusive (especially when she slashed Mr. Sir).
#[[Mr. Sir (Marion Sevillo)|Mr. Sir]] - The assistant warden at Camp Green Lake. He is grumpy because he has stopped smoking. His catchphrase is "this is not a girl scout camp."
#[[Mr. Pendanski ]]- The counselor for Group D at Camp Green Lake. 
#[[Barfbag (Louis)]] - A former camper at Camp Green Lake, he was placed in [[D-Tent|Group D]]. One day he got a rattlesnake to bite him to get out of Camp Green Lake. He was taken to a hospital and was replaced by [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)]].

==Town of Green Lake==
#[[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow)|Katherine (Kate) Barlow ]]- A school teacher in the town of Green Lake who became the outlaw Kissin' Kate. She infamously kissed every person she murdered.
#[[Sam|Sam the onion man]] - A black man who sold onions for a living. He and Kate Barlow were in love. When he and Kate Barlow kissed, he was shot and Kate became an outlaw.
#[[Trout Walker|Charles (Trout) Walker]] - A rich landowner who "owned the lake." He was called "Trout" because his feet smelled like dead fish. He was also in love with Kate Barlow, and he is revealed to be the Warden's grandfather.
#[[Linda Walker|Linda Miller Walker]] - Trout's wife. She is the Warden's grandmother. She was revealed to be in Miss Katherine Barlow's fourth grade class shortly before Katherine went insane and became Kissin' Kate Barlow.

==Yelnats Family==
#[[Stanley Yelnats III]] - Stanley's father. An inventor who was trying to come up with a cure for foot odor and a way to recycle old sneakers. At the end, he invents it.
#[[Tiffany Yelnats]] - Stanley's mother. At Stanley's trial, she told him to tell the truth.
#[[Stanley Yelnats I]] - Stanley's great-grandfather. He was robbed by Kate Barlow when he was moving from New York to California and was stranded in the middle of a dessert.
#[[Elya Yelnats]] - Stanley's great-great-grandfather. He was born in Latvia. He got the Yelnats family cursed when he wanted to marry a beautiful girl named Myra Menke. Madame Zeroni gave Elya a little piglet which he carried up a mountain to drink from a stream and sang a lullaby to it, so it would get large quickly until the day of Myra's birthday. He brought it to her but he realized that Myra didn't like him so he told her to marry Igor. He boarded a ship to America without keeping his promise of carrying Madame Zeroni up the mountain. He only realized that when the ship set sail but he thought she was joking. He later got married to Sarah Miller. According to [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)]] he nicknamed "a no-good-dirty-rotten-pig-stealing-great-great-grandfather".

==Latvian Characters==
#[[Madame Zeroni]] - A gypsy who cursed the Yelnats family. Stanley Yelnats broke the curse by carrying Zero up Big Wenis.
#[[Myra Menke]] - The beautiful girl who Elya wanted to marry. Igor Barkov and Elya offered their largest pig but their pigs both weighed the same so Myra (with her head as empty as a flowerpot) wanted each of them to pick a number from 1 to 10 to see which one she'll marry. Elya realized she didn't like him so he told her "Marry Igor. You can keep my pig as a wedding present."
#[[Igor Barkov]] - A pig farmer who also wanted to marry Myra Menke.
#[[Morris Menke]] - Myra's father and owner of the farm that Elya worked at and Igor farmed pigs at.

==Other Characters==
#[[Clyde "Sweetfeet" Livingston|Clyde Livingston (Sweet Feet)]] - A famous baseball player who Stanley is falsely accused of stealing shoes from him. He also endorses the product 'Sploosh' which was created by Zero and Stanley.
#[[Carla Morengo]] - Stanley's lawyer.
#Attorney General - The officer that checked for Zero's files (which had been destroyed by the Warden) and if any of the kids were missing at Camp Green Lake.

If Only, If Only.title: If Only, If Only
If Only, If Only.wikitext:
"If Only, If Only" is a song from Holes (both the book and the film). [[Elya Yelnats]] had to sing it to [[Madame Zeroni]]'s pig because of a deal he made with her. In the film, when [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)|Stanley]] and [[Zero]] run from Camp Green Lake, they find a stream, and Stanley sings <nowiki>''</nowiki>If Only, If Only" with a soft voice.

After Stanley was done singing, this unknowingly lifted the curse that Madame Zeroni had put on his family. At the same time, his dad found a cure for foot odor (Peaches and Onions).  At the end of the book, Zero's mother sings the full version of the song. 

There's three different interpretations of the song: Stanley's dad, Sarah Miller, and Zero's Mother. 

== ''English'' ==

=== Stanley's Dad's Interpretation ===
“If only, if only,” the woodpecker sighs,

“The bark on the tree was just a little bit softer.”

While the wolf waits below, hungry and lonely,

He cries to the moo—oo—oon,

“If only, if only.”

=== Sarah Miller's Interpretation ===
“If only, if only,” the woodpecker sighs,

“The bark on the tree was as soft as the skies.”

While the wolf waits below, hungry and lonely,

Crying to the moo—oo—oon,

“If only, if only.”

=== Zero's Mother's Version ===
If only, if only, the moon speaks no reply;

Reflecting the sun and all that’s gone by.

Be strong my weary wolf, turn around boldly.

Fly high, my baby bird,

My angel, my only

[[File:Austin_Gorg.jpg|thumb|Judge Austin Gorg]]{{Basic_Info_Template|title1=Judge Austin Gorg|location=Unknown (currently)}}
Judge Austin Gorg presided over [[Stanley Yelnats IV]]'s trial.

Though Stanley was innocent, the circumstantial evidence against him: [[Sweetfeet]]'s shoes had been stolen, Stanley had them, Stanley was a [[Clyde Livingston]] / [[Sweetfeet]] fan, and [[Stanley Yelnats III]] was recycling shoes to find a cure for foot odor.

The judge was hard-nosed and declared that he could send Stanley to jail and not lose one bit of sleep over that, But, as Stanley was a kid, he stated that [[Camp Green Lake]] had an opening - due to [[Barfbag (Louis)]]'s departure - and gave Stanley a choice, "Camp Green Lake... or jail."

At the near-end of the movie, [[Ms. Morengo]], Stanley IV's newly-acquired lawyer, managed to learn that Stanley's school had a bully by the name of [[Derrick Dunne]], who had stolen Stanley's notebook and tossed it in the toilet. Stanley was at school when the shoes had been stolen - by [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]].

The Judge immediately signed a court order for Stanley's release - which Ms. Morengo showed to [[The Warden (Louise Walker)]], who ignored it, since Stanley had run away days prior. Judge Austin Gorg was played by Michael Cavanaugh. The Judge is more of a minor character considering he only seen once in the movie and only mentioned once in the book.

Bitten by Yellow Spotted Lizard on the ankle (novel)|deathimage = Kate Bit.png |deathimage2 = Kate Dead.png|deathcaption = Kate being bitten by a Yellow-Spotted-Lizard and then dying.}} {{Template:Quote|Start diggin', Trout.|Katherine Barlow’s final words before her death}} [[File:402full-kissin'-kate-barlow.jpg|thumb]] '''Katherine ''Kate'' Barlow''',''' '''(September 17th ,1882-October 12th. 1924), also known as '''Kissin' Kate Barlow''', was a former teacher-turned-outlaw in [[Green Lake, Texas]]. [[File:Th-65.jpeg|thumb|200x200px|Katherine Barlow]] ==Background== Katherine Barlow was born in [[Green Lake, Texas]] on September 12th, 1882. She became [[Camp Green Lake]]'s elementary and adult school teacher as a young woman, with the children and the men she taught loving her and her lessons. During this time, Barlow would also make the town's best spiced peaches, which made her develop a friendship with a farmer named [[Sam]]. They would often exchange a jar of spiced peaches for a bag of onions, respectively. One day, when Sam went to go deliver some onions to her, he noticed the leaking roof of the schoolhouse. He told her that he would fix it for her in exchange for three jars of her spiced peaches. Every time he fixed one thing, Miss Katherine would find another thing for him to fix, because she liked his company. This made them develop a relationship together, and they formed mutual affection. One day, she and Sam were discovered kissing each other, which was not allowed in the town at the time, due to the racism in the South. Sam was going to be hanged for this crime, so Barlow tried to reason with the drunk [[The Sheriff|sheriff]]. He did nothing to appease the situation, and even asked her to kiss him in exchange for her boyfriend Sam's life (In the film, he didn't make the exchange for Sam's life offer), which she refused. In the book, Miss Katherine insisted that he go across the lake, leaving [[Mary Lou]] behind. Katherine came with him and Trout shot him, Katherine was rescued unwillingly. In the movie, however, Sam was coming back from the onion field across the lake and Katherine was on the shore watching him. Katherine witnessed him being shot, and was so mournful and mad at his death, that the next day, she shot the sheriff hard in the back as he deserved and gave him the kiss he had asked for, leaving a red lipstick kissy kiss mark. ==Outlaw== Barlow became an infamous outlaw after Sam's death in 1904, killing multiple men and leaving a kiss on their cheek. She robbed numerous banks in Texas and several individuals including [[Stanley Yelnats IV (Caveman) |Stanley Yelnats IV (Caveman)]]'s ancestor, [[Stanley Yelnats I]], but rather than killing him, she left him in the desert to die. She became incredibly rich with the work of her labor before burying the money somewhere in the present-day Camp Green Lake. === Physical Appearance === Katherine was a woman of short height and nice figure. She had creamy white skin tone, blue eyes, button nose, small pink lips, snuggle teeth and long blonde hair. As a teacher her hair was curled in a ponytail or undo bun and wore shirts with long skirts and boots and primarily wore white and blue. As an outlaw her hair was straight and wore shirts with vests and jackets and belts with jeans and boots with a fedora hat and her signature "sexy" red lipstick. In her death scene in the movie, she also sports a white dress tightened by a brown belt along with her regular attire of the dark jacket, boots and fedora hat. In the novel however, near her death scene, she wore blue silk pyjamas along with turqoise studded black boots which stayed next to the cabin bed. ==Death== Kate Barlow returned to the lake 20 years after Sam's Death. Kate sat against Sam's boat, ''Mary Lou'', when [[Charles "Trout" Walker]] and [[Linda Walker]] (One of Katherine's former students) comes up and threatens to kill her. Kate replies, "Go ahead and kill me, Trout, but I sure hope you like to dig, 'cause you're going to be digging for a long time. It's a big, vast wasteland out there. You, your children, and your children's children will dig for the next hundred years, and you will never find it." A yellow-spotted lizard suddenly darts out from inside the upturned boat. Trout and Linda both try to shoot it but miss. She then grabs the yellow-spotted lizard, prompting it to bite her. Kate dies at the age of 42, while laughing at the couple, telling them to "Start digging" as the secret of the treasure's location died with her. She would eventually get the last laugh when the treasure is instead found by [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)|Stanley]] and [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]] (mainly because the majority of the loot was kept in the chest she stole from [[Stanley Yelnats I|the original Stanley Yelnats]], thus it and the contents therein are the legal property of his family). In the novel, Kate lived in the same log cabin that is presently owned by [[The Warden (Louise Walker)|The Warden]], staying there for the final 3 months of her life. She is woken up by the sight of Trout's gun as Trout threatens her. When Kate denies stealing the loot, Trout in response shoots and shatters one of the cabin's windows followed by Linda spotting a shovel, telling Trout that Kate buried the treasure. Kate is then dragged out in her pyjamas by Linda and Trout, walking barefoot with her legs tied loosely together across the hot dirt, scorching her feet. Kate is knocked by her legs by Linda the first time when Kate wanders around, then every time she stops walking, she gets hit by the shovel. After feeling the shovel dig into her back, Kate falls on the hard dirt. Kate, Trout and Linda spot a yellow spotted lizard. Linda and Trout try to apprehend it by Linda's shovel and Trout's rifle which both miss. The lizard lands and bites into one of Kate's ankles, wounding it and then licks up the blood. She tells Trout and Linda to start digging. When Trout and Linda ask her where she buried the loot, Kate dies while laughing. ===Killed By=== *Yellow-Spotted-Lizard on the arm (movie)/Yellow-Spotted-Lizard on the ankle (novel) *Herself ''(Caused in the movie; accidental in the novel)'' *[[Charles "Trout" Walker]] ''(Indirectly Caused)'' *[[Linda Walker]] ''(Indirectly Caused)'' ''​[[File:KB.jpg|thumb|left|''Katherine when she was a school teacher'']]'' [[File:Kate2-jpg.jpg|thumb|Kate as an outlaw]] {{Characters}} [[Category:Characters]] [[Category:Characters in Movie]] [[Category:Characters in Book]] [[Category:Side Characters]] [[Category:Green Lake (Town)]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Deceased]] [[Category:Antagonists]]

'''Linda Walker '''(nee '''Miller''') (December 8th, 1895-December 27th, 1973) is a minor posthumous character in Holes. She used to be one of [[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow)]]'s students. In the book, Linda was only featured twice, when she was forcing Katherine to give her 'the loot'. However, she was mentioned to be around 10 years old in the first setting when she was a student of Kate Barlow, and to have been 'cute, freckly and redhead' as a child. In the movie, she was seen several times, possibly to explain that she was a former student of Katherine. However, despite Kate saying

that she 'was such a good student', she sided with Trout when they were taking the loot. Despite having a minor role, she was important in Katherine's life.

Linda is the wife of [[Charles "Trout" Walker]] and the late paternal grandmother of [[The Warden (Louise Walker)]], the late mother of Louise's late father and also the late mother-in-law of Louise's late mother.

==Childhood==
As a little girl, Linda was one of Katherine's favorite students. Linda was apparently a smart and cute girl as a child, and it seems that Katherine enjoyed teaching her when she was in the 4th grade, as she appeared several times in the movie. It is assumed that her grades were good, as according to Katherine she was a good student as a child. She was remarkably beautiful. Linda had vibrant red hair, and freckles and in the movie she had big, cute eyes. It is likely that she remembered her childhood when deciding to join Trout in digging holes, and considered the other side. 

In 1911 at age 17, Linda married Trout Walker, who possibly married her because of her beauty or her intelligence or quick wit (Though Katherine thought she 'married him for his money'). 

It was revealed in a republished Holes book with author notes that Linda and Sarah Miller (Stanley Yelnats IV's great-great-grandmother) simply shared the same surname and were not intended to be related.<ref>"Sarah Miller and Linda Miller are not related. It was a mistake by me [Louis Sachar] to give them each the same last name, and one I regret everytime someone asks me about it." -Louis Sachar, 10 THINGS YOU MAY NOT KNOW ABOUT ''HOLES.''</ref> 

==Appearance==
Linda was described as to keep her red hair as a grown-up, but it detracted from her appearance. She was described to have red blotches on her face, and she was presumably angry-looking. Linda was probably this way due to lack of money. She presumably wore dirty clothes, as she could not afford to keep them clean. She also sports dirty and scraggy hair.

Her granddaughter Louise inherited her sapphire studded boots as well as her red hair.

== Digging Holes ==
As the lake had dried up following Sam's murder in 1904, Trout and his family (including Linda) became increasingly poor and desperate, while Katherine had turned into an outlaw, plundering loot from rich travelers including [[Stanley Yelnats I]] (the great-grandfather of camper [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)|Stanley Yelnats IV]]). During Linda's first 13 years of marriage with Trout, she would dig holes with him in order to look for Katherine's buried treasure till they encountered her in 1924, 20 years after the lake had dried up. The couple would threaten Katherine, but she committed suicide by making a [[Yellow Spotted Lizard]] fatally bite her before she could reveal the location of the loot to Linda and Trout. For the remainder of Trout and Linda's life,  they would spend all their time digging holes, and force their children and later grandchildren to do the same (though Linda was less keen on it than her husband was). By the time she and Trout were elderly folks in 1959, her 11 year old granddaughter [[The Warden (Louise Walker)|Louise Walker]] would have started helping the family dig holes (which increased in amount as she grew older, even after the death of her grandparents). Louise presumably started Camp Green Lake as a young woman, and she had been keeping it that way until she was arrested in 1998, when it was sold to a Girl Scout facility. She probably wanted to see what was inside the loot as she had been digging for a long time and to honor Linda.

Lump was one of the B-Tent boys at Camp Green Lake, the resident bully, apparently in charge of the rec room, demanding that other camp residents `pay up' for some unknown due (Perhaps from gambling with shower tokens, the only `currency' available at the camp - from a deleted scene)

Lump was present when [[Mr. Sir (Marion Sevillo)]] was orientating [[Stanley Yelnats IV]] on how things worked at Camp Green Lake. Lump was in charge of the supply tent, setting out Stanley's jumpsuit and boots, taking and storing Stanley's backpack. Lump laughed when Stanley was trying to get into his jumpsuit, got his leg caught, and fell over.

The D-Tent boys still razzed Stanley until one day, in the rec room, Stanley was bumped into Lump by accident. Lump kicked Stanley, and when Stanley tried to right himself, he tried to apologize, but he slipped on an unstable stool, and landed on the bully, making it appear like he tried to take Lump on. Lump attempted to beat up Stanley, but the other D-Tent boys backed Stanley up, calling Lump off with fear of reprisals from the Warden. Lump backed off, "Keep that punk away from me!" seemingly shaken that a mere newbie had dared `attack him on his turf. [[Squid (Alan)]] warned Stanley not to even look at Lump "He's crazy, you understand me?" 

After witnessing Stanley stand up to the [[Lump]] in the Wreck Room, the boys respected Stanley for standing up for himself and acknowledged him under his newly given nickname Caveman. In the novel, Armpit explains to the Lump that 'no one messes with the Caveman'. In the film, Magnet delivers this line instead.

Lump was present in the mess hall as a server when Squid asked Mr. Sir what happened to his face, and was harshly disciplined by being thrown to the ground, knocking everything over.

|location = Latvia (formerly)|name = Madame Zeroni|image = file:Madame Zeroni1.webp|cause of death = Old age (Assumed)|gallery=n/a}}Madame Zeroni (September 12th, 1753), was [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]]'s great-great-grandmother and an overarching character in [[Holes Wiki|Holes]]. Madame Zeroni was the woman who cursed [[Elya Yelnats]] and his family line. She was portrayed by the late Eartha Kitt.

== History ==
It started when [[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] asked for Madame Zeroni's help in wooing the empty-headed-but-beautiful [[Myra Menke]].

Madame Zeroni agreed, she handed [[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] a piglet that could be offered as a dowry and had to compete with a rival suitor, [[Igor Barkov]]'s fattest pig.

[[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] would carry the pig up the mountain every day and sing [[If Only, If Only]] as it drank from the uphill-flowing stream, so it would get big and fat. Doing this would also cause him to grow stronger from carrying the pig up the mountain every day. The day that [[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] presents [[Morris Menke]] with the pig, he would return to Madame Zeroni, carry her up the mountain one last time, and sing [[If Only, If Only|If Only]] to her as she drank. [[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] was happy to do so, since Madame Zeroni was a friend, and not in the best of health.

Unfortunately, [[Elya Yelnats|Elya]] finally learned that he wasted his time with the airheaded Myra Menke. He left his pig as a wedding present, and signed up on a boat heading to America, just like Madame Zeroni's son did. But [[Elya Yelnats]] never went to go back and carry Madame Zeroni up the mountain.
[[File:Warning Elya Yelnats.PNG|alt=Madame Zeroni warning Elya Yelnats.  A closeup of a colored older woman with grey hair and headwrap.|thumb|Madame Zeroni warning [[Elya Yelnats]].]]
Madame Zeroni placed a 150-year-long curse on [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)|Stanley Yelnats IV (Caveman)]]'s family, because his so-called no-good-dirty-rotten-pig-stealing-great-great-grandfather [[Elya Yelnats]] did not complete his end of a bargain he made with her. Thus, his descendants would be cursed "for always and eternity."

== Trivia ==

* Her curse seemed to keep girls from being born and for some reason, have the men born afterwards have the same name.

* By the end, it would seem to be a roundabout boon. As this allowed the Yelnats family to become rich and prevent Kate Barlow from killing the first Stanley.

* In a post-credit scene for Holes, Zero reenacts Madame Zeroni's warning at the end, with the difference of Zero smiling compared to Madame Zeroni's stern expression, before the screen cuts to black.

== Before Camp Green Lake ==
Before Camp Green Lake, he was kicked out of University for hacking and editing grades. He was hired by the Warden for his computer skills.

== At Camp Green Lake==
'''Mr Pendanski''' (b. October 6th 1966) also known as Mom is the camp counselor of tent D and “Dr. Pendanski" in the movie. He starts off as kind, but his nice guy facade wears off soon after he finds out that [[Caveman (Stanley Yelnats IV)]] is teaching [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)]] how to read, and Pendanski starts to mock Zero for his so-called lack of intelligence. Right before Zero hits Pendanski with a shovel, Pendanski kept mocking Zero by giving him simple words to spell. Mr Pendanski in the movie asks Zero "What does D-I-G spell?" to which Zero whacks Pendanski with a shovel, answers “DIG!”, and runs off. 

In the novel, The Warden asks Zero sternly in front of the other counselors  with what the words such as C-a-t, F-a-t, and H-a-t spell, humiliating Zero. He concentrates hard and correctly guesses Cat and Fat but incorrectly responds with Chat. The counselors laugh and Mr Pendankski blurts out that 'he's so stupid, he doesn't even know he's stupid.' Zero confesses that he is not digging any more holes, before whacking Mr Pendanski in the face with the shovel. Zero then proclaims that he hates digging holes and runs off while the counselors all have their guns drawn at him. 

Mr Pendanski under The Warden's command is told to destroy Hector's file to keep his whereabouts hidden. Near the end of his, Mr Sir's, and The Warden's arrests, Mr Pendanski makes the announcement to both the campers and the adults that Hector Zeroni's file is missing. Additionally in the novel, the Attorney General makes a further call to his office and states the contradiction of Mr Pendanski that Hector's files are found in his office database but he is having difficulty accessing or is unable to access them.  

==After Camp Green Lake==
What happens to Mr. Pendanski after getting arrested is unknown. He is in prison because he is a slave owner at Camp Green Lake, endangering the campers, impersonating a doctor, destroying Hector's files and possibly some other unknown charges along with [[Mr. Sir (Marion Sevillo)]] and [[The Warden (Louise Walker)]].

==Notes==
*In the movie when Mr. Pendanski fires his gun to signal the breakup of Zero and Zigzag's fight, he uses a rifle. However, in the novel, he uses a pistol.
*Only in the movie is Mr. Pendanski a fraud doctor, in the book he is just [[D-Tent]] supervisor, but still gets arrested regardless.

'''Marion Seville''', better known as '''Mr. Sir''' (b. 1941) is the head counselor at [[Camp Green Lake]], and the secondary antagonist of Holes.

[[File:Th-66.jpeg|thumb|214x214px|Mr. Sir at Camp Green Lake]]

==Before Camp Green Lake==
Marion Seville was arrested for an unknown crime in El Paso, Texas, USA, which considering the conditions of his parole, may have been an armed robbery, assault with a weapon or murder, or all of the above. However, it's implied he used a gun to threaten Girl Scouts so he could steal cookies from their troop. He was given the option of parole, on the condition that he never owns or be in the vicinity of a firearm. He assumed the alias of Mr. Sir to avoid his identity as a released felon being discovered during his time at Camp Green Lake, and was later recruited by [[The Warden (Louise Walker)|The Warden]] of the newly established [[Green Lake, Texas|Camp Green Lake]] to be in charge of delinquent teenaged boys.

==At Camp Green Lake==
While at [[Green Lake, Texas|Camp Green Lake]], Mr. Sir was the head counselor. He usually carried a handgun that he used to kill Yellow Spotted Lizards. Mr. Sir was the first person at Camp Green Lake that [[Stanley Yelnats IV]] meets. Mr. Sir was a heavy smoker but has quit smoking by the time Stanley arrives. He is seen eating from a sack of sunflower seeds, which he uses to suppress his desire to smoke. Some time passes and [[Magnet (Jose)|Magnet]] steals the sack of sunflower seeds from Mr. Sir's truck while a couple of the other boys distract him. 

When the boys are passing the sack around, [[Zigzag (Ricky)]] tosses the sack to Stanley, and it spills into his hole. Mr. Sir notices his missing sunflower seeds before even getting back to the main camp. He turns around and drives back to the dig site, and upon searching the holes discovers the sack of sunflower seeds poorly hidden in Stanley's hole. Stanley refused to let [[Magnet (Jose)|Magnet]] get in trouble, and willingly claimed he stole Mr. Sir's sunflower seeds, earning him Magnet's respect. Mr. Sir took Stanley to [[The Warden (Louise Walker)|the Warden]] and explained what had happened. 

The Warden had just finished painting her nails with her specially made nail polish. When Mr. Sir finished speaking, she asked Stanley if he knew what she was doing. She then scratched Mr. Sir across the face, causing him to collapse in pain. After Stanley left the cabin, the warden tells Mr. Sir that she liked him better when he was smoking. The Warden then told Stanley her nail polish was made from rattlesnake venom. 

Mr. Sir's face was badly scarred from the scratch, and upon seeing this, [[Squid (Alan)|Squid]] rudely asked Mr. Sir what had happened to his face as a way to insult him. Mr. Sir didn't appreciate the question and grabbed Squid and threw him to the ground in anger. Later, when it was time to refill the campers' water canteens, Mr. Sir pours Stanley's water onto the ground and has Stanley thank him for it. After [[Zero]] escapes, Stanley steals Mr. Sir's truck to go look for him and crashes it in a hole after digging, leaving Mr. Sir to fix the truck himself. When Stanley is found digging up one of his old holes with Hector, they find Stanley's great-grandfather's treasure stolen by [[Kissing Kate Barllow|Kissin' Kate Barlow]]. The Warden, Mr. Sir, and Mr. Pendanski show up to find Stanley and Hector trapped in the hole covered in Yellow Spotted Lizards. 

The Warden spots the chest and becomes excited. Mr. Sir offers to shoot the lizards but is stopped by the Warden, as the lizards can jump quite far. Stanley and Hector stay rigidly still until finally, the sun shines into the hole and the lizards retreat from the heat. The boys manage to get out of the hole and the Attorney General of Texas arrives to retrieve Stanley from the camp. However, one of the Attorney General's men notices Mr. Sir and recognizes him as Marion Seville. 

Mr. Sir is then arrested for carrying a firearm while on parole.

==After Camp Green Lake==
Later that day, Mr. Sir was arrested along with Mr. Pendanski and The Warden. He was also sent to prison for multiple different charges, these charges include: violating his parole by owning a firearm, destroying Hector's file, and for the endangerment and slavery of children. The Warden and Mr. Pendanski are also arrested for similar charges and all 3 are sent to prison.

Mr. Sir seemingly had an obsession with Girl Scouts, as he frequently made comments about the Camp Green Lake not being a Girl Scout camp. Even the Warden gave him a `What is your deal?' look when he remarked that Stanley's lawyer [[Ms. Morengo]]'s early arrival `wasn't Girl Scouts sellin' cookies'. This implies that perhaps one of his past offenses involved Girl Scouts.

Igor Barkov (Husband)|gender = Female|race = Latvian|location = Riga,(gulf) Latvia (location of death)|image = File:Myra Menke.jpg|center|frameless|title=Myra Menke}} '''Menke''' is a part of the sub-plot in Holes. She was considered a flowerpot (meaning she was dumb) and does not know how life works. Her father was the person who chose who she could marry. [[Igor Barkov]] or [[Elya Yelnats]] both proposed for her hand in marriage. Elya Yelnats noticed Myra one day while she was helping, and became infatuated with her. He spoke to his friend, [[Madame Zeroni]], who warned him that Myra’s “head is as empty as a flowerpot." Elya replies, "But she's beautiful." Madame Zeroni responds, "So is a flowerpot. Can she push a plow? Can she milk a goat? No, she is too delicate. Can she have an intelligent conversation? No, she is silly and foolish. Will she take care of you when you are sick? No, she is spoiled and will only want you to take care of her. So, she is beautiful. So what?" Despite Madame Zeroni’s advice, Elya couldn’t get over Myra’s beauty. 2 months before her 15th birthday (according to the novel) Igor had offered his largest pig for her. With Madame Zeroni's assistance, Elya raised a pig himself, carrying it up the mountain to the stream, of carrying the pig up the mountain, the pig was as big as Igor's offering, and Elya had become much stronger as well. When her 15th birthday came, Myra’s father had no reason to choose Igor over Elya because both Pigs weighed the same. As such, he let his daughter choose. Myra, having not had much experience with making her own decisions, couldn’t decide. Despite the fact that her choices were between Igor Barkov, a 57 year old man who was overweight, crude and lazy; and Elya Yelnats, a man around her own age who was hard-working and fit; she couldn't pick whom to marry. When she asked which pig weighed more, her father replied that they were the same, so she decided to choose a number between 1 and 10 to decide between them. Realizing that Madame Zeroni was right about Myra, Elya told her to marry Igor and keep his pig as a wedding present. He then angrily tore up the flowers he brought and stormed off. After Elya gave up on Myra it seemed that she was not happy with Elya's decision, seeing that she grimaced when slovenly and sweaty Igor embraced her. ==Biography of Sam The Onion Man ==
===Early Life===
'''Samuel <nowiki>''Sam''</nowiki>''' (March 17, 1883-April 22, 1913)  was born in [[Camp Green Lake|Green Lake]], Texas and later became a farmer as a young man. He grew onions for a living. [[Mary Lou|Mary]] [[Mary Lou|Lou]], his pet donkey, was acclaimed by Sam to be almost 100 years old because she ate his onions. Sam made various products out of onions, because he thought onions were the cure for everything. For example, he had an onion-based cream that he claimed would cure baldness and a special onion juice that he claimed would ward off yellow-spotted lizards, which worked unintentionally (but thankfully) on Stanley ( Caveman) and Hector ( Zero). One person he traded his onions with was [[Katherine Barlow|Miss Katherine Barlow]], Green Lake's teacher; she'd give him jars of peaches in exchange for onions.

===Fixing the Schoolhouse===
[[File:Sam Shot.png|thumb|277x277px|Right before Trout/Charles Walker shot Sam.]]
"At one point, Sam went into the school to deliver Barlow her onions in exchange for her peaches. He noticed the leaking roof and offered to fix it in exchange for 3 additional jars of peaches. Each time he would finish fixing one thing, Kate would find something else for him to fix because she enjoyed his company. This made them develop a relationship together, and they discovered mutual affection. One day, Barlow was crying for Sam and saying "Oh Sam, my heart is breaking." He gently grabbed her hand, and they shared a kiss. Patty then yelled at them, "Wujie will curse you."

===Death===
He was killed on April 22nd, 1913 at 30 years old. The kiss was seen by [[Charles "Trout" Walker|Charles Walker]], who happened to be riding past the school house on his horse. (In the book, they are seen by Hattie Parker, a resident of Green Lake.) Trout reported this to the sheriff, since at the time, a black American man was not allowed to kiss a white American woman. Sam was to be punished for his crime by hanging, had he not tried to run away first. He jumped in his boat and began to row away, hoping to perhaps evade his hanging, or at least extend the time he had. Charles, however, raced after him in his motor-power boat and shot Sam down. Kate watched the entire scene unfold, horror struck. [[Mary Lou]] was shot dead as well. Then, Kate starts crying and yelling ''SAM!''

===Killed By===
*[[Trout Walker]] by gun. 
*Crashing into Walker boat and drowning in the water

== Facts ==
*Sam appeared to curse Green Lake upon his death, seeing that until Trout's family finally got arrested from a crime, it never rained for nearly 100 years.
**It's possible that he is also descended from the Zeroni family; explaining why the rain stopped.
*Sam the Onion Man is portrayed by Dulé Hill.

Small Steps.title: Small Steps
Small Steps.wikitext:
'''Small Steps''' is a young adult novel. It is the spinoff sequel to '''Holes.'''



== '''Plot'''==
About three years have elapsed since ''Holes ™'' After being released from Camp Green Lake, a juvenile correctional facility, [[Armpit (Theodore Johnson)|Theodore "Armpit" Johnson]] is back home at [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austin,_Texas Austin, Texas], trying to rebuild a stable life by digging holes and installing pipes and [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irrigation_sprinkler sprinkler systems]. The only person who thinks that Armpit is any good is his 10-year-old neighbor Ginny McDonald who was born with [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cerebral_palsy cerebral palsy] and is unable to speak without stuttering (except when she is singing or doing math)

Armpit also reveals that he is taking small steps to improve his life:
#Graduate High School
#Get a job
#Save money
#Avoid fights
#Lose the nickname Armpit.

Armpit's life goes great until the day when [[X-Ray]], his friend from camp, shows up with a sure-fire moneymaking plan. He plans to sell tickets to a Kaira DeLeon concert happening there. Armpit is reluctant to do so at first, not wanting to throw his good life out of whack. X-Ray eventually urges him to go along with the plan.

At home, Armpit asks Ginny if she would pay different sums of money for a concert ticket. When he gets to $100 dollars, Ginny says no. Armpit informs her of what X-Ray said, that two tickets sold for $750 each in Philidelphia. Ginny does not believe what he says, stating that Armpit should not believe all the stuff X-Ray says.

The next day, Armpit stops at the A.T.M to get the money for the tickets. During his speech class, he is told along with the rest of the class about their next assignment, where they must bring in a stuffed animal and write a speech about why the animal should be voted "Ruler of the World."

Armpit and X-Ray go to the concert to buy the tickets. While listening to a Kaira-DeLeon, Armpit hears something odd: Kaira says his name in the song.

Armpit and X-Ray meet two other people named Felix and Moses. Felix and Moses talk with Armpit and X-Ray about money. Eventually, Armpit and X-Ray are able to buy the tickets.

Armpit talks with Ginny on the way home about how he had aced his economics test with help from what Felix said about money. He then remembers his speech and asks Ginny if he can borrow a stuffed animal for his speech. Ginny says yes and takes him to her room, which is full of stuffed animals. She shows Armpit some, all of which have disabilities (Can't hear, can't see, etc.). She finally shows him one she loves the most: A stuffed animal with a rabbit's body and a human's arms and legs that is named "Coo". Armpit asks if Coo has a disability. Ginny says Coo had leukemia, but they, "Don't talk about it".

Armpit gives a very convincing speech, but Coo does not win the election, and instead loses to an armidillo named Joe (Which was obviously made up along with the entire speech right on the spot) Armpit's crush, Tatiana, expresses her sorrow that Coo lost. Armpit decides to ask Tatiana if she wants to come to the Kaira DeLeon concert, and she agrees.

However, after Armpit tells X-Ray not to sell the last two tickets, Tatiana calls him and says she cannot come to the concert. Armpit decides to ask Ginny if she wants to come instead. Ginny agrees, and her mother approves.

Armpit orders X-Ray not to sell the tickets again (Having told X-Ray to sell them when he found out Tatiana couldn't go). X-Ray says there is someone on the other line of the phone who wants to pay $200 a ticket! Armpit still tells X-Ray not to sell them, with X-Ray agreeing reluctantly.

Armpit takes Ginny to the concert. He is willing to put in an extra eight dollars to buy Ginny a Kaira DeLeon tour t-shirt, but Ginny's mother has told Armpit not to use his own money. When they find their seats, they are approached by a security guard who asks to see their tickets. After searching, Armpit gives the guard the tickets, which he says are fake. Armpit reaches for the tickets, but is attacked by the guards. One guard asks what someone is "on". The guards call for a doctor and are talking about having to pump someone's stomache. Armpit looks up to see Ginny on the floor twitching and jerking uncontrollably. He realizes Ginny is having a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seizure seizure], but the guards refuse to let Armpit try to help.

Fortunately, Armpit and the guards are approached by the mayor. Armpit reminds the mayor of what she said to him the day he dug a trench in her yard for her sprinkler system. She orders the guards to let Armpit go. Armpit and Ginny are taken to the medical center where they meet none other than Kaira DeLeon, who had come to see if Ginny was all right. She invites Ginny to watch the show from backstage. Armpit follows.

After the concert (During which Armpit hears Kaira say his name in a [[Damsel in Distress|song]] again) , Kaira invites Armpit and Ginny to come to her dressing room and have a bowl of ice cream. They talk about Camp Green Lake. Ginny wants to tell Kaira Armpit's nickname from camp, but Armpit tells her not to. Kaira whispers something into Ginny's ear, with Ginny doing the same.

As they drive home, Armpit asks Ginny if she told Kaira his nickname. Ginny says she gave Kaira a hint, stating it was a part of the human body.

The next day, Armpit confronts X-Ray for giving him fake tickets. X-Ray tries to explain why he did it. Soon, Armpit gets a call from Kaira inviting him to come have breakfast with her at the Four Seasons. While taking a walk afterwards, Armpit tells Kaira that he will tell her his nickname on the condition that whatever body part it is, she must touch him there. Following through with the agreement, Kaira touches Armpit's armpit. Afterwards, Armpit almost kisses her. However, they are stopped by Fred, Kaira's bodyguard.

Soon, a police officer arrives at Armpit's home. She wants to talk about the fake tickets so she can help catch the person who sold them. Armpit feeds her false information that he bought the tickets from an Iranian man named Habib. Detective Newberg believes the story and leaves.

Some days later, Kaira sends Armpit a very emotional letter saying how much she misses him (And repeatedly saying she won't send it).

Armpit later gets a call from Kaira and tells her that he got the letter. She invites him to come to San Francisco with her for a while. Armpit agrees, leaving a note for his parents.

Around the same time, Detective Newberg says she has a suspect in the phony ticket scheme in custody. The suspect turns out to be X-Ray. He goes along with Armpit's, "Habib" story, but tells very obvious lies at the same time. Threatened with jail time for providing false information, X-Ray begins telling convincing lies.

Before Armpit leaves for San Francisco, Felix and Moses approach him and demand he give them the letter from Kaira or they will rat out X-Ray to Detective Newberg. After getting into a physical fight with them, he leaves for San Francisco.

In San Francisco, Armpit asks Kaira if she can write another letter for him so he can give it to Felix. Convinced he is using her, Kaira leaves in a huff.

At the hotel, Kaira leaves her bathroom, only to be attacked by her stepfather, who attempts to murder her. Armpit enters the hotel room to leave the letter and, hearing the fight, confronts Jerome. Armpit overpowers him and the police are summoned.

Back home in Austin, Armpit talks to X-Ray and Ginny about his experience. Detective Newberg also reveals that she is going to give up trying to figure out the ticket scheme. Before leaving, she also reveals she deduced that Armpit was involved, but thinks nothing of it.

The book ends with Armpit going over his new list of small steps.

#Graduate high school

#Spend two years at Austin Community College

#Transfer to the University of Texas

#Don't do anything stupid

#Lose the nickname Armpit.

Sploosh.title: Sploosh
Sploosh.wikitext:
After [[Zero (Hector Zeroni)|Zero]] runs away from [[Green Lake, Texas|Camp Green Lake]], he escapes into the dusty and almost lifeless desert surrounding the camp. There is no water nor foods for hundreds of miles in every direction. However, Zero manages to survive the arid landscape by drinking what he dubs, "'''Sploosh'''". '''Sploosh''' is a peachy nectar stored in old jars he found under the destroyed rowboat.

'''Sploosh''' was invented by [[Kissin' Kate Barlow (Katherine Barlow) Gallery|Kate Barlow]], however it was known as Spiced Peaches, and it involved onion juice in the process of making it. In 1904, after Kate and [[Sam]] are caught kissing, Sam is shot dead while on the lake on his boat. His boat, known as the [[Mary Lou]], was loaded full with Kate's peaches at the time he died. The boat sank and a century later, at Camp Green Lake, Zero and [[Stanley Yelnats III|Stanley]] (Caveman) survive on it.

== Trivia ==

* Clyde "Sweet Feet" Livingston also named a foot freshening product after '''Sploosh'''.
* Khleo Thomas, who portrayed Zero in the film, stated in a January 2020 livestream on his YouTube channel that the ingredients that were made to make the spoiled '''Sploosh''' were bananas, maple brown sugar oatmeal, honey and chocolate milk.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JkO1-sMekwI Holes Watch Along With Khleo Thomas]</ref>
